summary: Petition under Section 79(1)(f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for adjudication of disputes arising under the Power Purchase Agreement dated 31.7.2012 between KSK Mahanadi Power Company Limited and the distribution licensees of erstwhile State of Andhra Pradesh. _“(a) Hold and declare that the non-availability of the domestic coal from the coal linkage granted to the Petitioner and requiring the Petitioner to procure coal from the open market if on account of Change in Law in terms of Article 10 of the PPA;_ _(c) Direct the Respondents to receive and acknowledge the entire Supplementary Bills from the Petitioner for the arrears of amounts finally allowed by this Commission towards Change in law from the date of change in law notification till the date of final disposal of the present petition and issue necessary directions to the Respondents to pay such adjusted tariff in terms of PPA,_ _(d) Restore the Petitioner to the same economic condition prior to the occurrence of the Changes in Law by permitting the Petition and the amounts as per the computations set out in hereinabove or through a suitable mechanism to compensate the Petitioners as and when the financial impact of the Changes in Law arose; and_ _(f)Grant costs in favour of the Petitioner and against the Respondents for the present petition.”_ 7.
